Odoo 19 Backend Theme

Techy Backend Theme

Give your Odoo 19 backend an elegant, fancy and professional look. A modern indigo design language built with pure CSS — no JavaScript, no hacks, fully compatible.

Odoo 19.0 CSS Only Zero Configuration Lightweight & Safe

A modern face for your backend

Techy Backend Theme reskins the entire Odoo 19 interface with a refined indigo/violet palette: a dark gradient navigation bar, elevated card surfaces, gradient action buttons, polished tables and kanban cards, and silky smooth transitions — all delivered through a single stylesheet injected into the backend asset bundle.

Highlights

Everything your users see, refined

🌉 Dark gradient navbar

A deep navy-to-indigo gradient top bar with rounded hover pills, glossy edge highlight and vivid notification badges.

💎 Gradient primary buttons

Signature indigo-to-violet gradient on primary actions, with a soft glow and lift effect on hover.

📄 Card-style forms

Form sheets float as clean white cards with rounded corners and layered shadows over a soft dotted canvas.

📋 Polished lists & kanban

Uppercase muted table headers, gentle row highlights, and kanban cards that lift and glow on hover.

🎯 Fancy statusbar

The current workflow step is filled with the brand gradient; previous steps stay subtle and clickable.

✨ Smooth & accessible

Buttery transitions everywhere, slim custom scrollbars, and full respect for the user's reduced-motion preference.

Coverage

What the theme styles

Area Treatment
Top navigation bar Dark gradient background, white text, rounded hover states, deep ambient shadow.
Dropdown menus Rounded cards with soft shadows and indigo hover highlights.
Form views Elevated white sheet, dotted canvas background, glowing input focus, gradient status step, accent notebook tabs.
List views Clean surface, uppercase muted headers, soft row hover and clickable-cell underline.
Kanban views Card records with hover lift, tinted grouped columns, styled quick create.
Dialogs, badges, notifications Rounded modals with tinted headers, pill badges, shadowed toast notifications, gradient progress bars.

Technical notes

  • Implemented with a single CSS file injected into the web.assets_backend bundle — nothing is monkey-patched and no core behavior is altered.
  • All colors, shadows and radii are exposed as CSS custom properties (--ty-*) at the top of the stylesheet, making the palette trivially easy to rebrand.
  • Honors the prefers-reduced-motion accessibility setting automatically.
  • Depends only on the web module. Install, upgrade and uninstall cleanly like any standard addon.

Installation

  1. Copy the techy_backend_theme folder into your addons directory.
  2. Update the apps list (Apps → Update Apps List).
  3. Search for Techy Backend Theme and click Install.
  4. That's it — your backend instantly gets the Techy look.
